conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: I can’t set up my mobile banking! The app keeps crashing every time I try.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the inconvenience, sir. Can you tell me which version of the app you’re using?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Uh, I don’t know… the latest one, I guess? I just downloaded it!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Let’s try a quick fix. Please uninstall and reinstall the app, then use your registered mobile number to log in.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: This better work. I don’t have time for this!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I understand, sir. Once reinstalled, it should work. If not, I’ll escalate this to our tech team.
